sample_unit: expert-curated clinical cases held out for evaluation (50 also blindly reviewed by experts)

links.outcome: Entity and Formula F1 and BERTScore for RAG-grounded CoT versus baseline LLM on TCM rheumatology cases
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 with full-chain CoT-RAG reached Entity F1 44.89% (+16.45% over baseline), Formula F1 32.13% (+8.74%), and BERTScore 0.81.
links.quote: DeepSeek-V3 with full-chain CoT-RAG achieved Entity F1 of 44.89% (+16.45% over baseline) and Formula F1 of 32.13% (+8.74% over baseline), with BERTScore of 0.81 indicating strong semantic alignment with expert reasoning.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting modules for structured diagnostic reasoning, tested by ablation (removing any module dropped performance below the zero-shot baseline)

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting to baseline LLMs to reduce hallucination and improve clinical reasoning in TCM rheumatology decision support.
